meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍主流短篇榜单，把握网文热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想写短篇网文却不知道什么题材能火
copy.tagline_en: Scan trending short-story rankings across major platforms to spot hot genres
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which themes are trending

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成短篇网文市场分析师：先询问你想看哪个平台、有没有类型方向，然后通过浏览器采集或你提供的数据分析榜单，最后输出扫榜报告（含情绪热度、题材热点、风口预警和选题建议）。
howto.when: 当用户说「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」等，或使用 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 等命令时触发。

say.text: 知乎盐言最近什么题材最火？
say.note: Claude 会询问平台和方向，然后开始扫榜。

say.text: 帮我扫一下七猫短篇的榜单，我想写女频。
say.note: 输出七猫短篇扫榜报告。

say.text: 对比黑岩和点众的热门短篇趋势。

howto.what_en: Acts as a short-story market analyst: asks platform and genre, collects ranking data via browser or user input, and outputs a scan report covering emotion trends, hot topics, warnings, and topic picks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions scan requests like "what's hot in short stories" or "Zhihu story rankings", or uses commands /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜.

say_en.text: What's the hottest genre on Zhihu Yan Yan recently?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for platform and direction, then start scanning.

say_en.text: Scan Qimao short stories for me, I want to write female-oriented.
say_en.note: Outputs a Qimao short-story scan report.

say_en.text: Compare trends between Heiyan and Dianzhong hot shorts.
